title: How to Use Parallel Data for Multilingual Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.28838v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-quality human-translated parallel corpora can improve cross-lingual transfer, but are typically too small for large-scale pretraining. Machine-translated web corpora help overcome this limitation, making parallel data available at pretraining scale. Standard multilingual pretraining, however, samples source documents and their translations independently, without explicitly using their parallel structure. We investigate how to use the parallel structure of the data to improve multilingual pretraining by concatenating each document with its translation in the same training sequence. We compare this parallel pretraining (PPT) approach with standard pretraining (SPT), training models from scratch at matched token budgets. Surprisingly, despite the benefits of parallel data reported in prior cross-lingual work, PPT alone does not consistently improve language understanding over SPT. translated_title: 如何在多语言预训练中使用平行数据
translated_abstract: 高质量的人工翻译平行语料库可以改善跨语言迁移，但其规模通常太小，无法用于大规模预训练。机器翻译的网络语料库有助于克服这一限制，使平行数据能够在预训练规模上使用。然而，标准的多语言预训练是独立采样源文档及其翻译的，没有显式利用二者的平行结构。我们研究了如何利用数据的平行结构来改善多语言预训练，方法是将每个文档与其翻译拼接在同一个训练序列中。我们将这种平行预训练（PPT）方法与标准预训练（SPT）进行比较，在匹配的token预算下从头训练模型。令人惊讶的是，尽管先前的跨语言研究报道了平行数据的益处，但仅使用PPT并不能持续改善语言理解能力。我们的进一步分析表明，尽管PPT构建了……
tldr: 该论文提出将文档与其翻译拼接在同一训练序列中的平行预训练（PPT）方法，并发现尽管平行数据有诸多益处，PPT相比标准预训练（SPT）并不能持续改善语言理解能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a parallel pretraining (PPT) approach that concatenates each document with its translation in the same training sequence, and surprisingly finds that PPT alone does not consistently improve language understanding over standard pretraining (SPT).
